COLDWAR_YUG_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SER IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized
		# start spirits
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_living_on_credit } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_living_on_credit }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_hangover_1965 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_hangover_1965 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_all_peoples_defence } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_all_peoples_defence }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_service_after_rankovic } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_service_after_rankovic }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_2 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme } } add_ideas = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme }
		# Brotherhood and Unity: discontent of the eight federal units, monthly drift adjustments, Federal Fund stage
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia = 40 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_slovenia = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia = 60 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_croatia = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia = 40 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_serbia = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_bosnia = 30 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_bosnia = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_montenegro = 30 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_montenegro = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_macedonia = 35 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_macedonia = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_kosovo = 65 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_kosovo = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_vojvodina = 35 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_drift_vojvodina = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 2 }
		# war phase: Territorial Defence arms, JNA loyalty
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_slovenia = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_croatia = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_serbia = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_bosnia = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_montenegro = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_macedonia = 100 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_jna_loyalty = 70 }
		# the Dinar: Debt Wall threshold (debt in % of GDP), Adriatic tourism and yearly payments (share of GDP)
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall_threshold = 35 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_tourism_gdp = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_tourism_factor = 1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_yearly_gdp = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exposure = 0 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion = 0 }
		# dynamic modifiers
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_state_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_state_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_economy_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_economy_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_army_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_army_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_security_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_security_modifier } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_foreign_modifier } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_foreign_modifier } }
		# internal factions (communist cadres, labour unions, farmers keep the values of the 1970 baseline)
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = communist_cadres_opinion } } set_variable = { communist_cadres_opinion = 50 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = labour_unions_opinion } } set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = 50 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = farmers_opinion } } set_variable = { farmers_opinion = 50 } }
		COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_stage = yes
		COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_lever_costs = yes
		COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_surrender_cap = yes
		COLDWAR_YUG_update_party_programmes = yes
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_YUG_month_next_day = global.num_days }
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_slovenia = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia max = 80 } }
	COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_stage = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_find_highest = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_bosnia > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_bosnia } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_montenegro > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_montenegro } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_macedonia > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_macedonia } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_kosovo > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_kosovo } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_vojvodina > COLDWAR_YUG_high } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high = COLDWAR_YUG_disc_vojvodina } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 8 } }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_highest = {
	COLDWAR_YUG_find_highest = yes
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 1 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_slovenia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 2 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_croatia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 3 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_serbia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 4 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_bosnia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 5 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_montenegro = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 6 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_macedonia = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 7 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_kosovo = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high_unit = 8 } } COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_vojvodina = yes }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_stage = {
	COLDWAR_YUG_find_highest = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high < 40 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high > 39 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high < 60 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high > 59 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high < 75 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high > 74 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high < 90 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high > 89 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_1 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_2 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_4 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_bau_5 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_YUG_monthly = {
	# the death of Tito: approved fixed date 4 May 1980 (fired by the tick, independent of the start date)
	if = { limit = { date > 1980.5.3 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_federation_dissolved } }
		# Brotherhood and Unity: monthly drift of every unit
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = COLDWAR_YUG_drift_slovenia }
		COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_slovenia = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = COLDWAR_YUG_drift_croatia }
		COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_croatia = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_provincial_veto } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = COLDWAR_YUG_drift_serbia }
		COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_serbia = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.4 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.7 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = COLDWAR_YUG_drift_bosnia }
		COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_bosnia = yes
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 1 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.4 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 2 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 3 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }

		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_provinces_subordinated } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = 0.4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = -0.5 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_delta = COLDWAR_YUG_drift_vojvodina }
		COLDWAR_YUG_change_disc_vojvodina = yes
		# a unit at 90 for twelve months (without Tito)
		COLDWAR_YUG_find_highest = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_high > 89 } NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_months_at_90 = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_months_at_90 = 0 } }
		# the Old Marshal: Communist cadres opinion floor 30; Enterprise Autonomy: Labour unions opinion floor 20
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal check_variable = { communist_cadres_opinion < 30 } } set_variable = { communist_cadres_opinion = 30 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_enterprise_autonomy check_variable = { labour_unions_opinion < 20 } } set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = 20 } }
		# the Dinar: 'The Debt Wall' when debt passes the threshold (25% once 'Living on Credit' has run eight years since the first credit focus)
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_living_on_credit }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wall = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall_threshold }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_YUG_credit_since }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_credit_days = global.num_days }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_credit_days = COLDWAR_YUG_credit_since }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_credit_days > 2920 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wall > 25 } } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wall = 25 } }
			}
			divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wall = 100 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { debt_ratio > COLDWAR_YUG_wall } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall_fired } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_debt_wall_fired country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.2 } }
		}
	}
	# Between the Blocs: valid while non-aligned; a bloc swaps it
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs NOT = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_blocs_to_back_in_the_fold } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_back_in_the_fold } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_in_the_western_camp } }
		else = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_between_the_blocs }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
	}
	COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_lever_costs = yes
	COLDWAR_YUG_count_reunification = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_exyu_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t = 0.5 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = COLDWAR_YUG_last_casualties } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_c = casualties_k } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_c = COLDWAR_YUG_last_casualties } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_c = 0.5 } clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_c min = 0 max = 10 } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_c } }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_last_casualties = casualties_k }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_gain_mod }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_military_neutrality } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = -0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_srbfr_eastern_slavonia_line } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = -0.1 } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f min = 0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t }
	}
	else = {
		clear_variable = COLDWAR_YUG_last_casualties
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = 1 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_decay_mod }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_normal_country } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = 0.1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_srbout_lesser_state } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f = 0.2 } }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f min = 0.1 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_f }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion = COLDWAR_YUG_exh_t }
		if = { limit = { has_war = no } subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_exposure = 1 } }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_exposure min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion > 74 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion > 49 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion > 24 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } }
	else = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_war_exhaustion_3 } }
	COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_surrender_cap = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_wargoal = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_wargoal_srbds_c1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_wargoal_srbdss_c1 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_wargoal_srbfr_c2_2b } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = -0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_wargoal_srbfr_r } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = -0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_wargoal_srbsrs_pm } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time = -0.5 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_for_justify_war_goal_time min = -0.5 max = 1 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_surrender_cap = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_cap_modifier } } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_excess_neg = 0 } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_cap_modifier } }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_sl_t = modifier@surrender_limit }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_sl_t = COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_excess_neg }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_sl_t = 1 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_sl_t min = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_excess_neg = COLDWAR_YUG_sl_t }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_surrender_excess_neg = -1 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_set_fund_stage_1 = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_fund_stage = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_2 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_2
				add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_1
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_3 }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_3
				add_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_federal_fund_1
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_lever_costs = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_fund = 50 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = 75 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = 100 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_guarantees = 75 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = 75 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = 75 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_arbitrate = 100 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = 75 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project = 0 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_infiltrate = 50 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project_kosovo_gdp = 0.008 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_old_marshal } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_tito_dead } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_fund = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_guarantees = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_arbitrate = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = 25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project = 25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_minus_10pp } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_fund = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_guarantees = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_arbitrate = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_10_ref COLDWAR_YUG_party_ref_governs = yes } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_fund = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_guarantees = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_arbitrate = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = -10 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge_cost_minus_25pp } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge_cost_jna } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge_cost_sps COLDWAR_YUG_party_sps_governs = yes } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge = -50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in_x_cost_minus_25pp } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in_x_cost_cut } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_currency_25_ref_lw2a } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_currency_25_fed_c1_1a } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_currency_plus50 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency = 50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate_cost_sps COLDWAR_YUG_party_sps_governs = yes } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate_free_once NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_subordinate_free_used } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm_to_cost_25 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm_to_cost_cut } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = -25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm_cheaper } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm = 50 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_infiltrate_free } set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_infiltrate = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_lever_cost_kosovo_project } set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project_kosovo_gdp = 0.005 } }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_fund min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_currency min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_purge min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_guarantees min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_subordinate min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_jna_in min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_arbitrate min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_disarm min = 0 }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_YUG_cost_project min = 0 }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_update_party_programmes = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_skj_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_skj_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_skj_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_skj_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_skj_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_skj_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_kom_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_kom_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_ref_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_ref_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_ref_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_ref_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_ref_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_ref_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_prx_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_prx_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_prx_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_prx_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_prx_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_prx_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_sps_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_sps_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_sps_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_sps_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_sps_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_sps_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_jna_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_jna_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_jna_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_jna_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_jna_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_jna_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_mon_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_mon_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_mon_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_mon_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_mon_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_mon_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsps_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_srbsps_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsps_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsps_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsps_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsps_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsrs_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_srbsrs_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsrs_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsrs_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsrs_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbsrs_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_srbspo_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_srbspo_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbspo_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbspo_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbspo_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbspo_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_srbds_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbds_programme } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_e COLDWAR_YUG_party_srbdss_governs = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_programme } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_programme } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_programme } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_YUG_srbdss_programme } }
	COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_lever_costs = yes
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes } }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_secede_slovenia = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_exists = SLV } any_owned_state = { is_core_of = SLV } }
		release = SLV
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_seceded_slovenia
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_succession_wars_open
		# the infantry equipment of its Territorial Defence goes with it (300 per brigade, arms / 10 brigades)
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_slovenia }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = 10 }
		round_temp_variable = COLDWAR_YUG_to_n
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n > 0 } has_equipment = { infantry_weapons_type > 299 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = infantry_weapons_type amount = 300 target = SLV }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = 1 }
		}
		SLV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.30 days = 1 } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_YUG_secede_croatia = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_exists = CRO } any_owned_state = { is_core_of = CRO } }
		release = CRO

			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = 1 }

COLDWAR_YUG_secede_bosnia = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { country_exists = BOS } any_owned_state = { is_core_of = BOS } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { country_exists = RSK }
				OR = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_serbia < 50 }
					COLDWAR_YUG_party_sps_governs = yes
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_rs_release_waived
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_rsk_release
				}
			}
			release = RSK
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_seceded_rsk
			RSK = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.30 days = 1 } }
		}
		release = BOS
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_seceded_bosnia
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_succession_wars_open
		# the infantry equipment of its Territorial Defence goes with it (300 per brigade, arms / 10 brigades)
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = COLDWAR_YUG_to_arms_bosnia }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = 10 }
		round_temp_variable = COLDWAR_YUG_to_n
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n > 0 } has_equipment = { infantry_weapons_type > 299 } }
			send_equipment = { equipment = infantry_weapons_type amount = 300 target = BOS }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_to_n = 1 }
		}
		BOS = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.30 days = 1 } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_YUG_release_above_75 = {
	# every unit above 75 leaves the federation (Serbia stays)
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_slovenia > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_slovenia = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_croatia > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_croatia = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_bosnia > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_bosnia = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_montenegro > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_montenegro = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_macedonia > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_macedonia = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_kosovo > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_kosovo = yes }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_disc_vojvodina > 75 } } COLDWAR_YUG_secede_vojvodina = yes }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_dissolve = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_federation_dissolved
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_succession_wars_open
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_confederal_union } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_confederal_union }
	COLDWAR_YUG_count_reunification = yes
}

COLDWAR_YUG_count_reunification = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 0 }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 124 owns_state = 125 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 126 owns_state = 127 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 128 owns_state = 1051 owns_state = 1052 owns_state = 1053 owns_state = 1054 owns_state = 129 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { owns_state = 135 owns_state = 136 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { owns_state = 134 } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_mnt_counts_reunif } } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_kosovo_weight_half } owns_state = 133 } add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_reunif_count = 1 } }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_spread_long_war = {
	if = { limit = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war COLDWAR_YUG_refresh_surrender_cap = yes }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SLV SLV = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } SLV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = CRO CRO = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } CRO = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = BOS BOS = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } BOS = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FYR FYR = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } FYR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = MNT MNT = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } MNT = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = KOS KOS = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } KOS = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = VOJ VOJ = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } VOJ = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = HZG HZG = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } HZG = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = RSK RSK = { COLDWAR_YUG_at_war_with_ex_yu = yes NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_long_war } } } RSK = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_YUG.70 } } }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_deals_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_credits_for_belgrade_USA } country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_credits_for_belgrade } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_USA = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_credits_for_belgrade_USA value = 1 days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_clearing_account NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_clearing_account_SOV } country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_the_clearing_account } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_SOV = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_clearing_account_SOV value = 1 days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_arms_oil_and_credits_SOV } country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_arms_oil_and_credits } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_SOV = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_arms_oil_and_credits_SOV value = 1 days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_balkan_brotherhood NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_balkan_brotherhood_BUL } country_exists = BUL BUL = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_the_balkan_brotherhood } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_BUL = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_balkan_brotherhood_BUL value = 1 days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_danube_compact_HUN } country_exists = HUN HUN = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_the_danube_compact } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_HUN = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_danube_compact_HUN value = 1 days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_yugoslav_cosmonaut NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_yugoslav_cosmonaut_SOV } country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_partner_signed_the_yugoslav_cosmonaut } NOT = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_clear_SOV = yes } }
		# IMPERIA COLD WAR — B8 24.11.2026: deal suspended for a year instead of broken for good
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_broken_the_yugoslav_cosmonaut_SOV value = 1 days = 365 }

COLDWAR_YUG_calculate_weekly_income = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_weekly_income = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_YUG_initialized }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_yearly_gdp }
		set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t = COLDWAR_YUG_tourism_gdp }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t = COLDWAR_YUG_tourism_factor }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = gdp_total }
		divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = 52 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_credits_for_belgrade_yug country_exists = USA }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk = USA.gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk = 0.002 }
			divide_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk = 52 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_arms_oil_and_credits_yug country_exists = SOV }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk = SOV.gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk = 0.002 }
			divide_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk = 52 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_the_danube_compact_yug country_exists = HUN }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk = HUN.gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk = 0.002 }
			divide_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk = 52 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_stabilisation_fund_wk = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_stabilisation_fund_yug country_exists = USA }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_stabilisation_fund_wk = USA.gdp_total }
			multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_stabilisation_fund_wk = 0.002 }
			divide_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_deal_stabilisation_fund_wk = 52 }

COLDWAR_YUG_calculate_partner_weekly_income = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_weekly_income = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_credits_for_belgrade_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_credits_for_belgrade_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_arms_oil_and_credits_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_arms_oil_and_credits_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_the_danube_compact_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_the_danube_compact_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_stabilisation_fund_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_stabilisation_fund_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_old_alliance_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_old_alliance_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_yugo_america_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_yugo_america_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_iron_gates_partner country_exists = SER } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_iron_gates_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_westinghouse_krsko_partner country_exists = SER } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_westinghouse_krsko_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_soviet_reactor_krsko_partner country_exists = SER } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_soviet_reactor_krsko_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_vver_fleet_south_partner country_exists = SER } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_vver_fleet_south_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_umm_qasr_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_umm_qasr_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_tripoli_contracts_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_tripoli_contracts_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_orao_line_partner } set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t = gdp_total } multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t = 0.002 } divide_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t = 52 } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = COLDWAR_YUG_wk_t } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_kuwait_tanks_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_kuwait_tanks_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_migs_moscow_partner country_exists = SER } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_migs_moscow_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_tivat_repair_yards_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_tivat_repair_yards_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_border_trade_albania_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_border_trade_albania_wk } }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_YUG_offer_cairo_contracts_partner country_exists = SER } subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_wk = SER.COLDWAR_YUG_deal_cairo_contracts_wk } }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_weekly_income = COLDWAR_YUG_wk }
}

COLDWAR_YUG_raise_jna_corps = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_template = "JNA Corps" } }
		division_template = {
			name = "JNA Corps"
			priority = 1
			regiments = {
				Mech_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 0 }
				Mech_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 1 }
				Mech_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 2 }
				Mech_Inf_Bat = { x = 0 y = 3 }
				armor_Bat = { x = 1 y = 0 }
				armor_Bat = { x = 1 y = 1 }
				SP_Arty_Bat = { x = 1 y = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_div_count > 0 } }
		capital_scope = { create_unit = { division = "division_template = \"JNA Corps\" start_experience_factor = 0.15" owner = ROOT } }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_YUG_div_count = 1 }
	}
}
